item.title: Sound Bath with Daemein Smith (Prioritizing Peace)
item.description:
Saturday, July 25, 2026 at 8 AM

Location: The Commons

Join us for a peaceful morning experience in Hermann Park with a free guided Sound Bath led by Daemein Smith of Prioritizing Peace. Set against the natural beauty of the Tsuru Family Terrace in the Commons, this immersive meditation experience uses sound and vibration to promote relaxation, mindfulness, and emotional well-being. Guests are encouraged to slow down, reset, and “Prioritize Peace” through a calming journey of sound healing in nature.  Tsuru Family Terrace Saturday, July 25  8 – 9 a.m.  Free Community Session Parking: Free parking available across the street from the Commons in Lot S (6215 Main St, Houston, TX 77030). Additional street parking available along Main Street. Guests are encouraged to bring a yoga mat if available. Blankets and pillows are also recommended for additional comfort. All ages and experience levels welcome.

From Hermann Park Conservancy

item.title: McGovern Centennial Gardens Volunteer Day
item.description:
Saturday, July 25, 2026 at 8 AM

Location: McGovern Centennial Gardens, 1500 Hermann Drive, Houston, TX, 77004, United States

Join us every Saturday for hands-on gardening projects at the McGovern Centennial Gardens. From 8 a.m. to 11 a.m., come help with seasonal tasks like planting, weeding, mulching, and pruning. A great way to connect with others and make a visible impact in the Park! No experience needed. All ages are welcome. Meet at the Family Garden in McGovern Centennial Gardens. Click here to sign up!

From Hermann Park Conservancy

item.title: Park to Port Bike Ride
item.description:
Saturday, October 24, 2026 at 8 AM

Location: Bayou Parkland, 6532 Almeda Rd, Houston, TX, 77021, United States

Hermann Park Conservancy’s 12th annual Park to Port Bike Ride is set for Saturday, October 24. The 20-mile round-trip bike ride takes cyclists from Hermann Park’s Bayou Parkland along the Bayou Greenway trail all the way to Mason Park, near the Port of Houston. Enjoy the turn-around party, but be sure to save some energy for a well-deserved post-ride party under the Bill Coats Bridge! Park to Port is open to riders of all skill levels and is not a race. Whether you are an experienced cyclist or are riding just for fun, you can go at your own pace on this scenic city journey. Your participation in Park to Port supports Hermann Park Conservancy and its stewardship efforts for one of Houston’s most beloved parks while promoting the ever-growing Bayou Greenway trail system. Register and learn more at the following link: 12th Annual Park to Port Bike Ride. Early bird pricing is available until August 17. SPECIAL OFFER: Save $10 on registration when you sign up for BOTH the Park to Port Bike Ride and Run in the Park! Bundle deal is available via the link above. Information on Run in the Park can be found here.

From Hermann Park Conservancy
